title: Authoring editor component (compose generate + edit + upload + preview + save)
description: Assemble the headline deliverable: a `<BlogAuthor>` component that ties the pieces together. The user enters a brief, triggers Claude generation (TASK-004), edits the resulting PortableText, uploads photos (TASK-006), sees a live preview (TASK-003), and saves to Sanity (TASK-005). Provide a clean props/events API so a host app can drop it in with only Sanity config and the AI/save hooks. Handle loading, error, and dirty/unsaved states.
acceptance_criteria: End to end in an example app: brief -> AI draft -> manual edits -> photo upload -> live preview -> save to Sanity.
The component exposes a documented props/events API (Sanity config in, save + AI hooks in, save/change events out) with full TypeScript types.
Loading, error, and unsaved-changes states are handled and visible to the user.
Saved posts read back correctly through the TASK-002 read path.

comments.author: init-project
comments.body: Reshaped from generic seed. This is the primary public component of the library.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Per sanity-writes research: <BlogAuthor> receives the `SanityWriteAdapter` ({ save, uploadImage }) as a prop — the component never holds a Sanity write token. AI generation is likewise a host-injected hook. Keep all secrets (Sanity write token, Anthropic key) outside the component; the host wires them via props/adapters.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: DONE + VERIFIED + REVIEWED. <BlogAuthor> composes generatePostBody (TASK-004) + BlogPostPreview (TASK-003) + ImageUploader/appendImageToBody (TASK-006) + adapter.save (TASK-005). Flow: brief -> AI draft -> edit title/excerpt -> upload photos (append w/ _key) -> live preview -> save -> emit saved({_id}). Secrets out (adapter + injected generate hook; aiOptions documented server-side). loading/error/dirty handled. Verification: build OK, 84/84 tests (10 author, incl. clear-propagation), lint 0 errors. Reviewer (author-reviewer) PASS, ran the suite itself (83->84 after fix). Fixes applied: read-back contract documented on initialPost, meta-clearing normalized (nonEmpty guard, not dependent on ImageUploader), _brief param dropped. Scope boundary: no WYSIWYG block editor (documented). DEFERRED: new-post slug/publishedAt for read-back -> TASK-011 (needs user product decision).
